players.product: temporary bonders / debonders for HBM wafer thinning, UV projection scanners and coaters for CoWoS, die-to-wafer hybrid bonders

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 release (beyond the call): Q2 group sales were EUR 116.2 million versus EUR 86.6 million in Q1, and gross margin rose to 38.0% in Q2 from 36.2% in Q1; order intake was EUR 149.3 million in Q1 and a record EUR 260.7 million in Q2. The release describes the approximately EUR 115 million coating-solutions order as coming from an OSAT customer supplying a leading player in the AI chip module value chain. At the beginning of Q3 SUSS shipped a first scanner for panel processing to a customer in Taiwan, with additional product launches planned for H2 2026.
